svg.title: Sable Harbor Advisory — AI-native operating architecture executive brief
svg.desc: US Letter executive brief on the established Advisory letterhead system summarizing the September 8, 2026 Advisory and Atlas Meridian operating model.
svg.text: EXECUTIVE BRIEF
08 SEPTEMBER 2026 | SH-ADV-MEM-20260908-001
AN AI-NATIVE PROFESSIONAL-SERVICES BUSINESS
Matter-led. Outcome-priced. Atlas Meridian-enabled. Built to transfer capability rather than dependency.
THE MODEL
The matter—not the billable hour—is the unit of production. A client brings Sable Harbor a consequential
problem. Advisory frames it, observes reality, builds understanding, intervenes within accepted authority,
proves what changed, transfers durable human and machine capability, and exits cleanly.
THREE PRACTICES · ONE BENCH
INTELLIGENCE ADVISORY
What is actually happening, what should we believe, and what should we do?
INTELLIGENCE CAPABILITY
Build the client's own durable intelligence institution and system.
OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE
Improve hard physical operations without giving away protected Sable Harbor IP.
ATLAS MERIDIAN
Atlas Meridian is both a commercial product and the professional workbench for Advisory. Its dedicated
team is a product-development organization—not a consulting pool. For clients, Atlas becomes the secure
front door for evidence transfer, matter records, provenance, collaboration, value measurement, agent
constellations and capability handoff.
OUTCOME ECONOMICS
Core work is not sold as hours × rates. The working measurable-value default is a target fee against
verified addressable value, approximately 60% committed / 40% outcome-variable. An independent Value
Office certifies baselines and outcomes. Atlas licensing is separate from professional matter economics.
TALENT AND J2 FIREWALL
Advisory may recruit aggressively from operating lines and the external market. It may not recruit, court,
pre-negotiate with or open an application for a serving J2 professional. Carry is reserved to qualifying
former J2 professionals; it creates exceptional economic upside without conferring line authority.
THE CLIENT PROMISE
NO PURCHASED CONCLUSIONS. NO FALSE PRECISION. NO AUTHORITY LAUNDERING.
NO DEPENDENCY THEATER. NO HIDDEN PYRAMID.
DESIRED END STATE
“We can now do something we could not do before, we understand why it works, and we know when
the next problem is hard enough to call Sable Harbor again.”
SABLE HARBOR ADVISORY • CONTROLLED BUSINESS ARTIFACT • CONTROLLING DECISION: SH-ADV-ATL-DR-001
“ADVISORY” REMAINS A PROVISIONAL DESCRIPTIVE COMMERCIAL LABEL
